name: The Floor Gives Way
notes: FR-4 demo: stepping on the loose flagstone swaps the tile underfoot and dims the torchlight. The script has no sceneId — the zone set's scene is inherited when the zones file is resolved (see examples/trapdoor-zones.json). Validate with `bun run cutscene --file examples/trapdoor.json --validate-only`. Honest limit: swapTile by cell needs a tile at that cell — the cell path has no tile cache yet (see src/session/tile-ops.ts), so if the live run fails on the swap step, find the tile's _id from a fresh scene read and use {"tile": "<id>"} instead of {"cell": ...}. The zone is fireOnce, so a failed run leaves the zone spent — re-arm it (or restart the watcher) before retrying.

steps.content: The flagstone sinks underfoot with a grind of stone — and the torchlight gutters.
Dust settles. The way forward is darker now.
